answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 20565 Country: Bangladesh Title: if someone says his wife talaq 3 times at the same time out of anger and frustaration due to her daliverate mis-behaivior, will talaq be count as 3 or 1 or not at all? Both husband and wife want to continue the relationship and they have 2 children. Question: Assalamu Alaikum, if someone says his wife talaq 3 times at the same time out of anger and frustaration due to her daliverate mis-behaivior, will talaq be count as 3 or 1 or not at all? Both husband and wife want to continue the relationship and they have 2 children. Answer ID: 20565 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 446/376/B=1431) When he pronounced three talaqs, the three took place. In the age of the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) ,a sahabi named Hadhrat Owaimir Ajlani ( رضى الله تعالى عنه ) gave his wife three talaqs in front of the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ). The holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) implemented all the three ones, the words of hadith are as follows: فطلقها ثلاث تطليقات عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فأنفذه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم و كل ما صنع عند رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم سنت . (ابو داؤد ج:1/ص:307) This hadith is sahih . After giving three talaqs it is not lawful to take wife back without halalah . The holy Quran says it clearly: فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلاَ تَحِلُّ لَهُ مِن بَعْدُ حَتَّىَ تَنكِحَ زَوْجاً غَيْرَهُ . [البقرة : 230] Thereafter, if he divorces her, she shall no longer remain lawful for him unless she marries a man other than him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
